footNoteCopy.footNoteCopy: The restaurants and cafés in the Village open thirty minutes before the boutiques open. VILLAGE CLOSED: 1 and 6 January, 1 May and 25 and 26 December. December 31, open from 10:00 to 19:00. Opening hours are subject to change.

childMarkdownRemark.html:
At the end of your shopping day in the Village, claim your frequent flyer points simply by sending an email to FrequentFlyerRewards@larocavillage.com with your proof of membership, your shopping receipts and an edited image of the bank card used (displaying only your name and the last 4 digits).

For terms and conditions, please click here.

Please note that GBP (£) refers to spend in Bicester Village only, and Euro (€) refers to spend at the Villages in Europe.
